description: This file provides initialization and handling routines for system tick timers on various PowerPC-based microcontrollers, including configuration, ISR installation, and start functions for timers like PIT and RTC, specifically tailored for MPC560X and MPC5604P platforms.

methods.name: void Os_SysTick_MPC560x(void)
methods.description: ISR for handling system tick on MPC560X platform, clears the API interrupt flag and calls OsTick.

methods.name: void Os_SysTick_MPC5xxx_PIT(void)
methods.description: ISR for handling system tick on MPC5604P platform with PIT, clears timer interrupt flag and calls OsTick.

methods.name: void Os_SysTickInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes the system tick timer by installing the appropriate ISR depending on the platform.

methods.name: void Os_SysTickStart(TickType period_ticks)
methods.description: Starts the system tick timer with the specified period, configuring the timer registers for different platforms.
